title: Cumbre Vieja eruption and Lyn Buchanan's warning

tellings.quote: And by the way, when it was going off, I was in communication with him being like, "Lynn, do you think this is it? Like, should I leave New York? I was in New York."

plain: When the Cumbre Vieja volcano on La Palma erupted in 2021, the researcher Jason Jorjani was in New York, and he says he got in touch with Lyn Buchanan, a former Army remote viewer, someone trained to describe distant events with the mind. Jorjani tells Michels he asked Buchanan, "do you think this is it? Like, should I leave New York?" His question suggests Buchanan had warned of something earlier, though Jorjani does not spell out the warning here.
